# P0/P2 — SEO meta: remove the email leak, write real descriptions

## 1. P0 — Gmail address leaked in `twitter:data1`

The homepage currently outputs:

```html
<meta name="twitter:data1" content="tobyadeyemo@gmail.com">
```

This is scrapeable by spam harvesters and contradicts the professional-domain identity.

**Where to fix:** this tag is generated by your SEO plugin (Yoast/Rank Math/SEOPress) or an
Elementor site-settings field — look for a "Twitter card → additional data / contact"
field in the SEO plugin, or Elementor → Site Settings → Site Identity. Remove the email
from that field. If you can't find it, search the WP admin for `tobyadeyemo` (some themes
store it under Customize → Contact Info).

**Replace with:** nothing (delete the data1/label1 pair), or your domain email once
`tobiloba@tobilobaadeyemo.com` exists. Never put a raw mailbox in meta tags.

## 2. P2 — Meta descriptions are literally "4.9/5"

Current state — all three of these contain only the string `4.9/5`:

```html
<meta name="description" content="4.9/5">
<meta property="og:description" content="4.9/5">
<meta name="twitter:description" content="4.9/5">
```

(The 4.9/5 rating claim itself is unbacked and slated for removal — see the testimonials
item — so it must not live in the meta either.)

**Replacement (≈150 chars, aligned with the locked canonical identity):**

```
Tobiloba Adeyemo — Cloud Security Engineer in South Africa. Identity & cloud platform security: audits, IAM hardening, and security reviews for SMEs.
```

Set this once in the SEO plugin's homepage description field; it should propagate to
`og:description` and `twitter:description` automatically. If the page title is also
templated, target: `Tobiloba Adeyemo — Cloud Security Engineer | Identity & Cloud Platform Security`.

## How to verify
- View page source (or use https://www.opengraph.xyz/) and confirm: no Gmail anywhere,
  all three description tags carry the new copy.
- Re-share the URL in WhatsApp/LinkedIn and check the preview card.
